summary: Iter 29 — Ride Stronger Phase 3 expansion (12 weeks / 3 phases / 36 rides) PASS + Couch-to-Road regression PASS. Backend 3/3 pytest in test_ride_stronger.py: (1) GET /api/plans returns ride-stronger with type=structured and week_count/duration_weeks == 12 (was 8). (2) POST /api/rider/plan {plan_id:'ride-stronger', reset_progress:true} then GET /api/plan returns id='ride-stronger', duration_weeks=12, current_week=1, progress.weeks='1 / 12', phases = [{number:1,'Foundation and Control',active:true,weeks:'Weeks 1–4'},{number:2,'Strength and Sustainable Power',active:false,weeks:'Weeks 5–8'},{number:3,'Goal Ready',active:false,weeks:'Weeks 9–12'}], workouts still lists Week 1 rides (rs-ride-1,2,3). (3) Regression: reassigning couch-to-road returns id='couch-to-road', duration_weeks=16, ctr-ride-1/2/3 present. Frontend verified via Playwright: after seeding roujaune_token in localStorage /plan screen shows 'Ride Stronger', '12 Weeks Duration', 'PLAN PROGRESS 0% 1 / 12 Weeks', and lists all three phases 1) Foundation and Control Weeks 1–4, 2) Strength and Sustainable Power Weeks 5–8, 3) Goal Ready Weeks 9–12 with phase 1 marked CURRENT PHASE. Live Workout: /workout?workoutId=rs-ride-30 opens Live HUD with title 'Peak Goal-Specific Training Ride', STEP 1 / 13 timeline of 13 authored interval blocks, NEXT UP Warm-Up Build 10:00 158 W RPE 2 (matches ride-stronger.ts intervals: Settle In→Warm-Up Build→…→Goal Block 1/2/3→Controlled Endurance Finish→Cool-Down). /workout?workoutId=rs-ride-36 opens Live HUD with title 'Ride Stronger Achievement Ride', STEP 1 / 13, 75.0 km / 150 min ride, NEXT UP Warm-Up Build (step 2), matching authored intervals Begin Your Strongest Ride→Warm-Up Build→Endurance Block 1–4→Easy Reset→Goal Block 1→Recovery Endurance→Goal Block 2→Confidence Endurance→Controlled Achievement Finish→Achievement Cool-Down. Coach cue on rs-ride-36 said 'Ease that power up just a touch, Green Lantern, you need 184 watts to settle in properly.' — proves authored RPE/target targets are wired end-to-end for Phase 3 (rs-ride-25..36). 'Video unavailable' shown in the embedded YouTube player is EXPECTED per the review note. Finally re-assigned couch-to-road via API — GET /api/plan returned id='couch-to-road', duration_weeks=16, current_week=1; Green Lantern is left on the beginner plan as required.
